summary: First-pass smoke test of LaunchPad MVP (backend + frontend). All critical user flows pass end-to-end: auth (register + admin login + Bearer/me + logout/401 on protected), startups listing (5 seeded with tasks), apply/join, task claim, GitHub submission + auto-approve, verified profile (XP=20-30, tasks_completed=1, skills_earned populated, startups/submissions enriched), and PDF certificate download (content-type=application/pdf, body starts with %PDF). Frontend landing/register/login/dashboard/startups/kanban/profile/cert-download all work with the documented data-testids. One minor note: backend register expects `year` as a string (Pydantic v2); the React form already sends a string, so end-to-end UI register works. Posting `year: 3` (int) returns 422 — acceptable for current contract but worth flagging.
passed: POST /api/auth/register (year as string) -> user + Bearer token returned
GET /api/auth/me with Bearer token -> 200 with user payload
GET /api/tasks?startup_id={id} -> seeded tasks; POST /api/tasks/{id}/claim moves task to in_progress and assigns user
POST /api/tasks/{id}/submit with github_url -> submission status=pending; POST /api/submissions/{id}/auto-approve -> status=approved
GET /api/profile/me after completion -> tasks_completed=1, experience_points=20, stats.skills_earned=['React','SSE'], startups+submissions enriched with task_title/startup_name
GET /api/profile/me/certificate -> 200, content-type application/pdf, body starts with %PDF
Frontend / -> hero-cta-register & hero-cta-login present, LAUNCHPAD branding visible
Frontend /register form (reg-name/email/password/university/major/year/submit) -> redirects to /dashboard and shows the user's name
Frontend /startups -> 5 startup-card-{id} elements; opening detail shows kanban + tasks
Frontend startup-join-btn -> joins; task-claim-{id} -> in-progress; task-submit-{id} + submit-github-url + submit-confirm -> task auto-approved (verified via profile stats XP=30, Tasks=01, Skills=02)
Frontend nav-profile + profile-download-cert -> triggers GET /api/profile/me/certificate with 200 application/pdf

failed.issue: POST /api/auth/register rejects `year` when sent as integer (Pydantic expects string). Frontend already sends a string so UI works, but the API contract is type-strict and undocumented.
failed.evidence: {'type':'string_type','loc':['body','year'],'msg':'Input should be a valid string'} on year:3 (int). Works with year:'3'.

action_items: Optional: accept both int and string for `year` in RegisterRequest (e.g. Union[int,str] with coercion) or document that year must be a string.
